$comment: pnpm-cli single source of truth: version = upstream pnpm version (independent semver). Binaries are NOT committed; CI builds libpnpm_cli.so and tools/provision.mjs deploys it. The current entry is a DRAFT placeholder: size/sha256 are pinned by the first real CI build. See docs/000-工程规划.md. Decision record (2026-10-30): pnpm 12+ is a Rust standalone binary; repo created on that basis (workspace doc §9.3).

releases.name: libpnpm_cli.so

builtFrom.source: pnpm <ver> source tarball (github.com/pnpm/pnpm), unmodified; Rust standalone binary cross-compile
builtFrom.runtimeDeps: node must be on PATH (package lifecycle scripts are JS, executed by node) - consumer pairs with io.github.fellow99:node-cli
builtFrom.ndk: TBD (first CI build pins NDK line + version)

openProbes: upstream android-arm64 prebuilt availability (esbuild/biome-style optionalDependencies: most likely absent) - CI self-build regardless (no upstream binary downloads)
Rust deps (napi-rs? ring? tokio?) compilability probe on aarch64-linux-android (M3.5 exit gate)

IF the premise is falsified (NAPI hybrid loaded by node): FREEZE this repo plan and re-evaluate as a pty-style node-paired artifact (NODE_MODULE_VERSION pairing + napi symbol resolution in the node-cli process)

matrix.execPackaging: useLegacyPackaging=true (extractNativeLibs=true): exec requires physical files in nativeLibraryDir; targetSdk>=29 SELinux forbids exec from app data dirs
matrix.note: Exec-form tool; RUNTIME DEPENDENCY: node must be on PATH for package lifecycle scripts - pair with io.github.fellow99:node-cli. If the build emits DT_NEEDED libc++_shared.so, it is supplied by the consumer's node-runtime (do not bundle here).
